  Readable gloss: "The proper name Remaliah (רְמַלְיָהוּ) identifies the father of Pekah, who seized the throne of Israel by assassination (2 Kgs 15:25). Isaiah's deliberate use of 'the son of Remaliah' without the royal title (Isa 7:4–5, 9; 8:6) constitutes a pointed refusal to dignify the usurper — reducing him to his father's name alone. Spanish Remalías, French Remalia, and German Remaljahu each reflect the theophoric ending -yahu."
